l01_intro_01.text: Radio check. If you can hear me, you still owe me for the headphones.

l01_intro_02.text: Loud and clear, Opal. Put it on my tab.

l01_intro_03.text: The head in that deck came out of those ruins. Sold as-is. No refunds.

l01_intro_04.text: Bottom floor, biggest score, back by dinner. Easy money.

l01_outro_01.text: Opal. There were two of me in there.

l01_outro_02.text: Mm. Did either of you find anything worth selling?

l01_firstdeath_01.text: That one got me. Properly got me. And I'm back at the door.

l01_firstdeath_02.text: Mm. It does that. Try not to make a habit of it.

l01_idle_01.text: I'm billing you for this radio time.

l02_intro_01.text: One floor down and the price of that deck just went up.

l02_intro_02.text: You already sold it to me.

l02_intro_03.text: I sold you a Walkman. You're wearing a miracle. Different shelf.

l02_outro_01.text: Good crew. One quick, one patient, both gorgeous.

l02_outro_02.text: Crew. You've never split a take in your life.

l02_idle_01.text: Somebody carved every inch of this wall. Nobody signed it.

l03_intro_01.text: This place really wants me to be in two spots at once.

l03_intro_02.text: Most people bring a partner for that.

l03_intro_03.text: I did. She's great. Little bossy.

l03_outro_01.text: Take One stood there the whole time and didn't complain once.

l03_outro_02.text: ...Which is weird, because I would have.

l03_idle_01.text: You've gone quiet. Either you're thinking or you're dead.

l04_intro_01.text: Licensed survey, Tolliver Vance. You're not on my site list.

l04_intro_02.text: I'm not on anybody's list. That's the appeal.

l04_intro_03.text: This floor needs four people. My four went home. Sensibly.

l04_outro_01.text: That was all you. That was four of all you.

l04_outro_02.text: Write it up however you like, Tolly.

l04_outro_03.text: It's Tolliver. And I don't have a form for this.

l04_idle_01.text: Take your time! I'm only timing you for the report.

l05_intro_01.text: You're about to lose me. The rock gets thick from here down.

l05_intro_03.text: Don't sell anything without me. And don't you d--

l05_outro_01.text: Turns out I talk a lot when nobody's listening.

l05_outro_02.text: Take Three thought it was funny, though. I could tell.

l05_idle_01.text: Opal would have said something rude by now.

l06_intro_01.text: You again! Mind the next room. It's very pointed at people.

l06_intro_03.text: I've stopped counting the holes in my survey flag.

l06_intro_04.text: Stay back here, Tolly. Some of me are about to get shot at.

l06_outro_01.text: You sent yourself out as bait. Twice.

l06_outro_03.text: I'd offer to come along. You seem... staffed.

l07_intro_01.text: Headphones keep picking something up. It isn't Opal.

l07_outro_01.text: She skipped, she ran, she made it. I'd have waited. Probably.

l08_intro_01.text: Scavenger. One recording head. Four tracks. All kept.

l08_intro_03.text: I keep what this place records. You are keeping me busy.

l09_intro_01.text: Hey. Voice. What's at the bottom? Rumour says time machine.

l09_intro_02.text: The master deck. It does not replay. It records over.

l09_intro_03.text: So it's real. Opal owes me a drink.

l09_intro_04.text: Opal. Three takes. Kept. The fourth was never recorded.

l09_outro_01.text: All that 'sold as-is'. She knew exactly what it does.

l09_outro_02.text: She turned back at three. I've got four.

l10_intro_01.text: Okay, team meeting. One, you're reckless. Two, you're late.

l10_intro_02.text: Three, you were perfect. Don't let it go to your head.

l10_intro_04.text: Best crew I ever had. Nobody argues about the split.

l10_outro_01.text: The next door is mine. The rooms rewind. I do not.

l10_outro_02.text: So you'll remember me. Good. Most people do.

l10_idle_01.text: Four, you've been very quiet. I'm watching you, Four.

l11_intro_01.text: Everything you commit, I keep. Everything I keep, I have read.

l11_intro_03.text: Then I'll have to be somebody you haven't filed yet.

l11_outro_01.text: Four takes. None of them the one I expected. All kept.

l11_outro_02.text: It records over, Moxie. Go and look. Then decide what I lose.

l11_firstdeath_01.text: That step is from take one. I was already waiting in it.

l11_idle_01.text: I can wait. It is most of what I do.

l12_intro_01.text: That's it? It's a tape deck. A very big tape deck.

l12_intro_02.text: One reel. Every beat this place has kept. Wind it back and the rest is gone.

l12_intro_03.text: Any beat. I could fix the haircut. The red bike. That one night.

l12_intro_04.text: ...First things first. This room wants four of me.

l12_outro_01.text: Listen to that. All four of us. Nobody cut.

once_firstdeath_01.text: Okay. That killed me. And I'm fine. Not thrilled. Fine.

once_firstghosttake_01.text: Huh. See-through. Well, I'm here now.

once_firstdesync_01.text: She's skipping. Like a scratched record.

once_firstdesync_02.text: Catch up, you. We rehearsed this.

once_firstresetall_01.text: Whole tape, gone. Fine. They were all rehearsals anyway.

once_firstloot_01.text: First find. Opal will say twenty. It's worth sixty.

bark_countin_05.text: Quiet in the booth. That means you, Two.

bark_takecommitted_02.text: Lock it. She's on the crew.

bark_takecommitted_04.text: Nobody touch it. It's perfect. Ish.

bark_retry_03.text: Cut. I can do that prettier.

bark_resetall_02.text: Wasn't you, team. Was me. Was all of us.

bark_death_03.text: Meant to do that. For the next me.

bark_ghosttake_01.text: Tape's still rolling. So am I.

bark_ghosttake_02.text: Dead on tape. Still on the clock.

bark_rescue_01.text: Got you. You owe me. I owe me.

bark_rescue_04.text: She lives! Told you I'm good company.

bark_desync_03.text: That wall wasn't there last take.

bark_resync_03.text: Welcome back. You missed a lot.

bark_fail_01.text: Close. Not close enough to brag about.

bark_fail_03.text: The plan's good. The plan's fine. New plan.

bark_lasttape_01.text: Four, you're up. No pressure. All the pressure.

bark_win_03.text: Play it back. I want to watch.

bark_loot_03.text: This one goes on me, not on the shelf.

bark_bossrecall_02.text: Old trick. It kept the receipt.

ending_01.text: Choose your beat. I will not remember being asked.

ending_02.text: Every take I wanted to cut was holding a door for the next one.

ending_03.text: So don't rewind. Record. All four of me, one tape.

ending_04.text: ...Nobody has asked it to keep anything in a long time.

ending_05.text: And Opal's three. Those are coming up with me.

ending_07.text: --oxie? Eleven hours of static. Well? Did you find it?

ending_08.text: Found it. Bolted to the planet. Wouldn't sell it anyway.

ending_09.text: So you came up with nothing.

ending_10.text: I came up with a mixtape. And this. It has your name on it.

ending_11.text: ...Three tracks. I never did the fourth.

ending_12.text: I know. I played it. Hope you don't mind the company.

ending_14.text: Not for sale. Put the kettle on. I'll play you both.

stinger_01.text: I've drafted a form for you. It has four signature lines.
